CALIST PRO / Our Process / Stage 03

Post-Production

Post-production refines creative work and prepares it for delivery. The finishing process depends on the service, project requirements, and formats agreed during planning.

What happens

  1. Review and organize the created material, then select what best serves the project goals where selection is relevant.
  2. Refine the work through image or video editing, sound and colour adjustments, animation refinement, or design revisions as needed.
  3. Check the refined work against the project direction, requirements, and intended use.
  4. Prepare and export files in the formats agreed for the project.

Useful outcomes

  • Refined creative work prepared in line with the project requirements.
  • Relevant finishing decisions, such as image selections, edit treatment, sound or colour approach, animation detail, or design adjustments.
  • Files prepared for handoff in the formats agreed for the project.

Finishing steps and file formats depend on the service and agreed scope.

Across our services

Refinement focuses on what each medium needs to be clear, cohesive, and ready for its intended use.

Photography

Select and edit images, with relevant finishing adjustments suited to their intended use.

Videography

Edit footage and, where relevant, refine sound, colour, pacing, and the final export format.

Motion Graphics

Refine timing, transitions, animation details, and exports in formats suited to the agreed requirements.

Graphic Design

Refine layouts and design details, then prepare the files in the formats agreed for their use.

Careful finishing prepares the work for its next step.
